headline: President Bush set up a National Mathematics Advisory Panel to give the federal government advice on math education.
what_it_does: This executive order creates a national advisory panel focused on mathematics. Based on the title, the panel's job is to give advice to federal leaders, likely on how math is taught and learned. An advisory panel makes recommendations but does not set binding rules. Few details are available, so the panel's exact duties and makeup are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would receive advice and recommendations from the new panel.
They would serve on the panel and help shape its advice on mathematics.
